subject: Next steps and trial playbook — ClearVista quick pilot checklist
messages:
From: Alana Park <alana@clearvista.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T16:15:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks — quick follow up from today's call

Irene / Karthik,

Thanks for the walkthrough today — that was helpful. A quick recap from my side so we're aligned before we lock the pilot dates:

- Primary pain: high token cost and unpredictable tail latency impacting our customer-facing summarization feature.
- Current baseline: p95 latency for summaries ~750ms (peaks to >1.2s during spikes); avg cost per 1k tokens is significantly above our target.
- Goal for pilot: validate a 30-day workload that demonstrates 3x cost improvement or p95 latency < 350ms while maintaining Rouge/QA quality within 5% of current model outputs.

Next steps I need from Redwood to get internal approvals:
1) A short pilot playbook (scope, success metrics, who does what) that I can attach to our procurement note.
2) Security checklist (SOC2 artifacts and basic VPC/network requirements).
3) A tentative schedule with onboarding and eval milestones.

Irene — appreciate if you can also confirm whether we need VPC peering or if the hosted Dedicated offering can be used with IP allowlists.

Thanks,
Alana

--
Alana Park
Head of Data Products, ClearVista
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alana Park <alana@clearvista.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T18:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks — quick follow up from today's call

Alana — thanks for the succinct recap. Kept this short and pragmatic so you can forward to procurement/infra.

Pilot summary (proposed):
- Length: 30 days (opt to extend to 45 if additional evals requested)
- Scope: 10k monthly active users equivalent (we'll mirror your production prompt mix for summarization), up to 50 concurrent inference streams during peak testing windows.
- Success metrics (primary):
  * p95 latency <= 350ms for end-to-end summarization (including network RTT) OR 3x reduction in cost-per-1k-tokens vs current baseline.
  * Quality: automated evals (Rouge-L + custom classification checks) within 5% of current outputs.
- Deliverables: mutual action plan spreadsheet, security stub (SOC2 summary + evidence list), prompt/eval suite to validate quality regressions.

Access & infra options:
- Hosted Dedicated with IP allowlist: quickest path (no peering). We can create a dedicated pool in us-west-2 and restrict egress/ingress via allowlist.
- VPC Private (if you require peering): requires Network + Infra tickets on your side; redwood will provide a template for subnet/CIDR and route tables.

Immediate onboarding tasks (owners):
- ClearVista: provide a sample prompt set and two representative production requests, add a point-of-contact for firewall/IP provisioning (Alana).
- Redwood: share Mutual Action Plan and security stub, provision a test API key and a dedicated GPU pool (Irene / Marissa).

Tentative timeline:
- Day 0–2: sign-off + procurement (Alana + ClearVista procurement team)
- Day 3–5: access provisioning and initial smoke tests (Redwood infra)
- Day 6–12: run prompt-eval baseline and tune batching/kv caching settings
- Day 13–30: sustained workload runs, telemetry capture, and final readout

Attachments: I've attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan (spreadsheet) and the security-eval-stub for your infra folks.

If that looks good I will:
1) upload the playbook to a shared Drive link;
2) open a HubSpot line item and attach the mutual action plan so procurement has a single doc to review.

I'll also add Marissa to help with the evaluation prompts and the telemetry dashboard.

Best,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reeves <tom@clearvista.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Alana Park <alana@clearvista.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T07:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks — quick follow up from today's call

Irene / Alana — quick note from procurement side:
- We prefer Hosted Dedicated (IP allowlist) to avoid opening peering requests unless absolutely necessary.
- Procurement needs an itemized cost estimate for the 30-day pilot (projected spend cap) and a short explanation of SLA and data handling for logs.

Alana: can you confirm if finance is ok with a pilot spend cap of $12k? If so I can move forward with a PO.

Thanks,
Tom

--
Tom Reeves
Senior Procurement Manager, ClearVista
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reeves <tom@clearvista.com>, Alana Park <alana@clearvista.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks — quick follow up from today's call

Tom — appreciate the clarity. Confirming next items from Redwood (action owner in parentheses):

1) Itemized pilot estimate (Marissa Cole) — I'll ask Marissa to send a conservative spend estimate and a projected spend envelope for the 30-day run by EOD today. Attachment will include a line-by-line for capacity, telemetry retention, and optional A/B traffic split costs.
2) Security & data handling note (Irene Choi) — short memo summarizing SOC2 scope, what logs are retained by default, and how KMS/HSM integrations are supported. I'll attach the stub security-eval-stub.pdf now; full artifacts can be delivered under NDA.
3) Access plan (Karthik Iyer) — Karthik will share the exact IP allowlist steps and create the API key; expected completion within 48 hours of PO.
4) Playbook and MAM (Irene) — I'll post the Mutual Action Plan to the Drive link and share the HubSpot deal id so procurement has one reference.

If ClearVista confirms the $12k cap, we can consider that the financial guardrail for the pilot and will set throttling to prevent accidental overages.

I'll follow up with the attachments and HubSpot link in a separate message.

Best regards,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachments: ClearVista_MutualActionPlan.xlsx, security-eval-stub.pdf
